in_sanskrit.name: सर्वजीत

in_marathi.name: Sarbjeet
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे One who rules all
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sarbjeet हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sarbjeet is derived from the Sanskrit words 'sarv' meaning 'all' and 'jeet' meaning 'victory'. The name signifies a person who has the power to rule over all things. This name is a symbol of courage, strength, and wisdom.
